g.text: The REST API: 75 routes under /api/v1, who may call them, and the AI service's internal API
POST /auth/change-password · any signed-in account · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
POST /auth/logout · any signed-in account · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
GET /users/me · any signed-in account · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
GET /notifications · notification:read · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
POST /notifications/:id/read · notification:read · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
POST /notifications/devices · notification:read · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
DELETE /notifications/devices/:id · notification:read · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
POST /notifications/read-all · notification:read · Patient, Clinician, Pathologist, Admin
Each line: method, path, permission, roles that have it by default.
An arrow means the app's users have permission for at least one route in the group.
Every route except the public ones needs a valid access token.
Administrators can change role permissions (within locks).
